title: General Resources
note: The Task Force's document collection — plant blueprints, remedial investigation reports, consent decrees, groundwater and radiological survey data, and correspondence spanning the site's history — is archived at the Clarke Historical Library (Central Michigan University) and the Alma College Library Archives. Contact us if you're looking for something specific.
